snippet.title: '83 – Cold War Gone Hot Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist '83 on Steam Today: 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059220/83/

Press Kit: 🔗 https://tinyurl.com/bdgpresskit  

Alpha Testing Signup: 🔗 https://83thegame.com/83-alpha-tester/ 

‘83 - the spiritual successor to Rising Storm 2: Vietnam set in an alternate history 1983 where the Cold War escalated into a full-blown war.  

Take part in 40v40 combined arms battles with a focus on historical authenticity, ‘accessible realism’ and intense firefights – all while respecting your time as a player, ensuring that you can fit a battle or two in on a tight schedule. 

‘83 will be coming to Steam Early Access in late 2025. Until then, make sure to wishlist us on Steam, follow us across your preferred social platforms and join our growing Discord community to stay tuned on things ‘83. 

YouTube Content ID: HAAWK 

#tacticalshooter #pcgaming #coldwar #ussr #nato #ww3
